newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Floods kill two in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Floods kill two in Morocco.

text.p: Two people were killed by floods caused by torrential rain near Morocco's financial centre of Casablanca, the official MAP news agency said on Friday.
The rains, which hit Morocco in the past 24 hours led to floods in several parts of the country, MAP said.
A special government commission was set up under the interior ministry to order rapid interventions for emergencies, it added
More than 200 people were killed by freak floods in Morocco last year while most of the country was suffering from drought.
